package.description: Print Folders and Directory structure ergo Tree

en-US.description: Print Folders and Directory structure ergo Tree
en-US.longDescription: It is very easy to print the content of a directory with the folder print explorer! This Folder Print Tool for all MS Windows OS has a print preview with variable aspect ratio and also export functions to XLS, HTML, CSV, TXT. Supports MS Explorer Views plus Tree-List, tree-list-plus, filters & Console. This folder print explorer is an unknown Tool from the category file management on Software OK!
en-US.name: DirPrintOK

zh-CN.description: 打印文件夹和目录结构树
zh-CN.longDescription: 打印目录内容可以很简单！这款文件夹打印工具适用于所有微软 Windows 操作系统，具有可变长宽比的打印预览功能，还可以导出为 XLS、HTML、CSV 和 TXT。支持微软文件资源管理器视图、树状列表、树状列表+、过滤器和控制台。这款文件夹打印工具是 Software OK 上文件管理类的一个新鲜工具！
